Make a GIF

Makes a square, looping GIF (up to 1200 px; 600 is a good small size). It uses the menus above, so press New picture first if you changed any. Animate picks what moves. Motion and Signal noise add movement, and every loop is perfect. Music (optional) makes the picture move with the beat and loudness; the GIF is silent, and Make music video puts the music in a video. Preview one frame shows a single frame quickly, before you make the whole GIF. Spin, wave, noise and Signal noise make bigger files; Keep under can limit the size.

Paint on it

Press and drag on the picture to paint over it. Your brushes are cut from the pictures in the set you chose. Save PNG includes your painting.

Parameters of this picture (save them, or load a saved list)

This list describes the picture above. Press Save .txt or Copy to keep it. To bring a picture back later, paste a saved list into the box (or press Load .txt file), then press Apply.

Made something you love with my image sets? You are free to share it with attribution.
If you mint it as an NFT, or use it on socials, please credit "made with Paint with Paraxeno's generator" and tag @paraxenod on X, or even better, make it a collaboration. It is a courtesy I would really appreciate. The main photo sets are my own artwork.

Want to mint your picture on your favourite marketplace? Steps
  1. Press Save PNG (or right-click the picture and choose Save image as).
  2. Open your favourite marketplace and connect your Tezos wallet.
  3. Upload your picture and create your token, following the marketplace's own steps.
  4. In the description, write: made with Paint with Paraxeno, @paraxenod.
Marketplace screens change from time to time. If a step looks different, check the marketplace's help pages.

Each click makes a new painted picture from my photo sets, or from your images, then glitches it either automatically or under your settings. Pick things, add your own images, or let the seed surprise you.

"New glitch" keeps the picture and re-rolls the glitch. If Save PNG is blocked by your browser, right-click the picture and choose Save image as.

Questions, or something not working? Contact @paraxenod on X, and I will be happy to help. Thank you for visiting.
